note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, cross-checked by PlanetGTA6). Every guide below is written for this page in our own words and names its sources; where no unlock method is confirmed yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

sources.label: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)
The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.summary: Finish Chapters 1–5 and the named story missions. Do Lucia's Chapter 1 meditation the morning it appears, scan vehicles and animals as you travel, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and the game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist
roadmap.summary: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements but is closer to 60% true completion: most ask for only part of a total (200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets). Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can still be done in free-roam.
roadmap.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; The Gamers Hub 100% checklist

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
roadmap.summary: Finish the 8 stranger mission strands and any trophies left over from the first two stages. The five trophies with no confirmed unlock yet are checked here too — the guides update as the community confirms them.

platinum_note: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours to the platinum, in a single playthrough. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player — there are no online trophies. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for a trophy run.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops when the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task. PowerPyx rates the full run 4/10 and about 200 hours in one playthrough, and notes there is no multiplayer and no DLC required. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and cleanup.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the story — it pops on its own.
steps: Play Chapter 1.
Finish the mission Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 is complete — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Before Chapter 1 ends, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: it is the one thing in the chapter that may not come back.
steps: Play through Chapter 1.
Start Chapter 2 — the trophy pops with its first mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 2 is complete — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also when you can first switch between Jason and Lucia (after the mission Coffee Break), which opens the partner trophies.
steps: Play through Chapter 2.
Start Chapter 3 — the trophy pops with its first mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 3 is complete — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is a busy one for side content: Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's questlines all open here, and the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks with the mission Credit Check.
steps: Play through Chapter 3.
Start Chapter 4 — the trophy pops after its first two missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 4 is complete — PowerPyx notes it pops after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… also opens in Chapter 4, and it is the doorway to bank vault robberies.
steps: Play through Chapter 4.
Finish the mission Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks when the final mission is complete — PowerPyx lists it with Chapter 4's closing mission, Starting From Zero. It is the only gold trophy tied to the story; after it, the game continues in free-roam, so everything else on the list can still be earned.
steps: Play the story to its end.
Finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 2.
Complete the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 3.
Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and it cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Just follow the story — no extra step is needed.
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the whole second stage of the roadmap. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It has 35 requirements, but it is closer to 60% true completion: most ask for only part of a total — any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 15 of 18 card sets, any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions out of 200–300+. The tasks that allow no skips are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable — everything is still doable in free-roam after the story. PowerPyx and The Gamers Hub publish the same 35 requirements.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Work the partial counts first: vehicles, animals, challenges, meditations, card sets.
Finish the no-skip tasks: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 14 drone-race locations, all 15 Target Decks.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. You can mix kinds freely, and PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the quickest to clear. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy.
steps: Pick a kind — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest.
Complete any 250 stunts across the four kinds.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most are introduced by the story itself or marked on the map with blue dumbbell icons, and PowerPyx notes you will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies — so do not chase this one, just check it off as it fills in.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types are missing.
Try each missing type once — the map's blue dumbbell icons mark most of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting ranges. There are no gold medals for story missions in this game — the only golds are these range challenges and the 13 race challenges — so this is the game's skill test. PowerPyx links a full guide to all 12 range locations and all 42 golds. The checklist needs all 42 as well, so this trophy and A Long Road finish together.
steps: Visit the 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total across them. PowerPyx links a guide to all 14 locations. The 100% checklist needs every location too, so this trophy finishes with A Long Road.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone-race locations.
Win at least one race at each.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — there are 40 unique race locations, so you only need half of them. PowerPyx links a guide to all 40 locations. Any race type counts, and a win also fills one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find race locations on the map.
Win 20 different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge and beat him. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and it builds the Focus stat that Gunslinger wants.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing icon.
Complete his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; the fourth is found at arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best; it also fills the video-game activity type for Master of None.
steps: Pick one of the 4 arcade games.
Play it at your home TV (first three games) or an arcade machine (Bang For Your Buck).
Finish all of its levels once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline on the map in Belville. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops with the last one. All of her quests are still available after the story. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and play as Lucia.
Take Andy's call, then follow her address to Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls you, and is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He offers sets of treasure-diving quests at shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures — a metal detector helps dig them from the ocean floor — and bring them back to him. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees, or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 — playing as Jason and calling Brian speeds it up — so the strand is not missable, and all his quests are still available after the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 1's Island Dreams, then take Kenton's call.
Follow the purple chest icons to the shipwrecks (green KR icon in Key Lento).
Clear all 7 shipwrecks and return the treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops with the last one. All his quests are still available after the story. Note: Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side quests found in the open world — but only certain questlines count. The game does not count the named optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) as strangers for this trophy. The strands PowerPyx confirms as counting are: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests — Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his deliveries). PowerPyx notes there are more strangers yet to be discovered. All of them are still findable after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have completed.
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed).
Complete 8 strands — the named character questlines do not count.
Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to him. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List — he marks some in fixed locations and more as you complete them, and scanning or entering a car he wants pops a delivery prompt. He is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City, and the cars turn up often in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. The whole strand can still be done after the story.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List to see the 16 cars.
Steal and deliver each car to Randy (green RK icon, west Vice City).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers for the Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City — go there and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy when finished. All of it is still available after the story. Note: Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty (as Jason).
Destroy the Synthetic Labs in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: one meditation at Jason's house exists only in Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts as +2, and you can track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: during Chapter 1, at Jason's house, Lucia meditates on the balcony — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to her in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out and choose Accept when she offers to show you how. That session adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, and it becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. It is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped — so do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this matters for the trophy, not for 100%. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept her balcony meditation.
After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, meditate at the 18 spots with both characters.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this strand is exclusive to Jason. Do the quest, and Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them. It is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so finish the whole strand. All of it is still available after the story.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then take Bret's text as Jason.
Meet Bret in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted) and take the Killtelligence SM-69.
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 set locations. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy is an early milestone on the way to A Long Road — keep collecting past the third set.
steps: Find collectible cards out in the world.
Complete any 3 sets.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the environment you scan by holding Up and then R1. There are more than 100 scannables, so it does not matter which 100 you pick: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, and No Flusher tags. Scan whatever you pass — landmarks and curiosities are everywhere — and the trophy comes naturally while you explore. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies share the habit.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) at scannable objects.
Scan any 100: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges and you only need 50 for this trophy — and the 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this pops automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; scrolling over a challenge shows a Completed checkmark in the bottom right. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% requirements, so leave this for late, then pick the easiest and quickest of what remains. PowerPyx links a guide to all 80 challenges.
steps: Play normally — most challenges complete while doing other trophies.
Check Progress > Challenges for what is left.
Finish any 50 (70 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest this can be done is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then cause enough carnage to reach a 4-star wanted level. The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone — not just the blue/red flashing search area. PowerPyx's escape tip: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, shooting down a chasing helicopter if needed, or driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank vault robberies there always trigger 4-star wanted levels.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — a fast bike or the Ambrosia train tunnel helps.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: You can only start this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets — the green icons on the map — while staying chased by police the whole time. You must keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. PowerPyx recommends an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and looting a couple of items in each store — ideally going into the back room and breaking the safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it has not popped, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and call your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop — or hit a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. The quickest method PowerPyx gives is to stand at a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1.
Stand at a busy road and scan everything passing by.
Reach 100 discovered (200 base models for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in a single use, and focus only lasts a few seconds. PowerPyx's setup: buff your focus first by eating or drinking, or washing your face or showering at home; consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to extend the focus time; line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nations so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 rather than a pistol or SMG. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus), raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you reach Focus Level 4 this gets much easier, and it may pop naturally.
steps: Buff focus (food, drink, shower) and take Adrenaline.
Find 5 grouped enemies, e.g. at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and drop all 5 in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not the planes sitting on the airfield, but one connected to a passenger boarding bridge. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane (you can also walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the unlock is a little delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Board it, enter the cockpit and reverse to the airstrip.
Take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — the Rhinos of the trophy's description. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Get in a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County).
Enter the base and get into a tank in the south of the base.
Shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon. Break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door offers the kick (which triggers the alarm) or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, enter the back room, look for the note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe. PowerPyx names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun (no alarm).
Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies. You tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, and the vault opens — go in quickly while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself: bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani — the fence unlocked in Chapter 3 — for tips about security vans; if you have not done his earlier quests yet, do those first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells the tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large banks in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this trophy pops on the way — and each vault pays up to $205,000, making it the best endgame money. Scrolling over a bank's map icon shows which vaults you have robbed.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
Tail a security van to a bank and rob the vault while it is open (bring your partner).
Escape the 4-star wanted level; repeat at 5 banks (8 for the checklist).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. Or do it earlier on your own: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after doing his quests (Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically either way.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (automatic).
Or: block an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way, per PowerPyx, is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Exploring as you travel during the story fills in much of it naturally; the final sweep is a cleanup job for stage 2.
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged area until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.count_label: 1 operation for each of 9 gangs (39 total)
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations. For this trophy you only need to complete 1 operation belonging to each gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops automatically on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your count per gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow map icons).
Rob at least 1 operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going to all 39 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the remaining valuables.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are many across Vice City), or work out at home after the story. Always go together with both characters: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), and while one actively works out the other completes the training automatically, so you make double progress.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Join a fitness club and work out with both characters together.
Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count out of 500 by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on criminal profile notifications in the settings (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right side of the screen. The profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, which makes cops more aggressive, so avoid it. It will almost certainly happen passively while you work on the other trophies and the checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it still has not popped at the end, PowerPyx's farming tip is to run over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies and encounters all count toward 500.
Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies; you do not need to bring it all at once. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist: the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, though those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver a total of $250,000 to a fence (Yasmani pays the most).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Simply spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way, per PowerPyx, is guns, car mods and tattoos, since those are the most expensive. The shop counts PowerPyx lists: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, and 15 electronics stores. Normal play — gearing up, modding cars, buying clothes — covers much of it; the bank vault money from Maximum Withdrawal makes the rest easy.
steps: Spend across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.
Reach $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages — for this trophy you only need the 8 purchasable ones. Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone. Buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones that unlock later in Chapters 3–4. Each garage also adds parking spots you need for On the Spot, so buy them before registering vehicles.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you must first buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. You unlock Moses from the same mission that unlocks the app. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering vehicles costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep expenses down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) for parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
